summary: National Health Investors filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Purchase and Sale Agreement to sell 35 senior living facilities (32 skilled nursing and three independent living) to NHC/OP, L.P., a wholly-owned subsidiary of National HealthCare Corporation, for $560 million. The properties span seven states and are currently triple-net leased to the purchaser under a master lease. The buyer makes a $5M initial deposit non-refundable after a review period ending May 29, 2026, then a $15M additional deposit; the seller must deposit $20M as liquidated damages if it terminates. No board recommendation or advisors named. Regulatory timeline not specified. Watch for buyer’s termination right during review period and deposit mechanics indicating mutual commitment.
